```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  fig.align = "center"
)

library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(patchwork)
```

## Load data

```{r load-data}
# Update this path if your file lives somewhere else in the repo.
data_path <- file.path("..", "data", "plotting", "biomarker_df_with_identifiers_values.csv")

# Fallbacks for knitting from different working directories.
if (!file.exists(data_path)) data_path <- file.path("data", "plotting", "biomarker_df_with_identifiers_values.csv")
if (!file.exists(data_path)) data_path <- "biomarker_df_with_identifiers_values.csv"

sites <- readr::read_csv(data_path, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  janitor::clean_names()

required_cols <- c("site_name", "site_number", "reporting_area", "p450", "sod", "ibr_bio")
missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, names(sites))
if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  stop("Missing required columns: ", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "))
}
```

## Prepare plotting data and colors

```{r prepare-data}
format_reporting_area <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- sub("\\.0$", "", x)
  x
}

# Current table includes 9 reporting-area levels:
# 6, 7, 8.1, 8.2, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13.
# The palette supplied in the prompt has 8 colors, so this code adds one
# controlled ninth color. Replace "#999999" if you choose a different ninth color.
ra_levels <- c("6", "7", "8.1", "8.2", "9", "10", "11", "12", "13")

ra_palette <- c(
  "6"   = "#E69F00",
  "7"   = "#56B4E9",
  "8.1" = "#009E73",
  "8.2" = "#0072B2",
  "9"   = "#F0E442",
  "10"  = "#D55E00",
  "11"  = "#CC79A7",
  "12"  = "#000000",
  "13"  = "#999999"  # ninth reporting-area color; edit if needed
)

plot_df <- sites |>
  mutate(
    site_number = as.character(site_number),
    reporting_area = format_reporting_area(reporting_area),
    reporting_area = factor(reporting_area, levels = ra_levels)
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(reporting_area))

# Safety check: stops if a reporting area is present without a color assignment.
missing_palette <- setdiff(levels(droplevels(plot_df$reporting_area)), names(ra_palette))
if (length(missing_palette) > 0) {
  stop("Missing reporting-area colors for: ", paste(missing_palette, collapse = ", "))
}

# Optional alternative: if you decide 8.1 and 8.2 should be collapsed into RA 8,
# uncomment this block and replace the ra_levels / ra_palette objects above.
# plot_df <- sites |>
#   mutate(
#     site_number = as.character(site_number),
#     reporting_area = format_reporting_area(reporting_area),
#     reporting_area = if_else(reporting_area %in% c("8.1", "8.2"), "8", reporting_area),
#     reporting_area = factor(reporting_area, levels = c("6", "7", "8", "9", "10", "11", "12", "13"))
#   ) |>
#   filter(!is.na(reporting_area))
#
# ra_palette <- c(
#   "6" = "#E69F00", "7" = "#56B4E9", "8" = "#009E73", "9" = "#F0E442",
#   "10" = "#0072B2", "11" = "#D55E00", "12" = "#CC79A7", "13" = "#000000"
# )
```

## Plot helpers

```{r plot-helpers}
theme_biomarker_ms <- function(base_size = 11) {
  theme_classic(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
      axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 6)),
      axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 6)),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.key.width = unit(0.8, "cm"),
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = rel(1.0)),
      plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = rel(1.2))
    )
}

make_biomarker_box <- function(df, y_var, y_label, panel_title) {
  ggplot(df, aes(x = reporting_area, y = .data[[y_var]], fill = reporting_area)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.35, color = "grey45") +
    geom_boxplot(
      width = 0.62,
      outlier.shape = NA,
      linewidth = 0.35,
      color = "grey25",
      alpha = 0.85
    ) +
    geom_point(
      shape = 21,
      color = "grey20",
      stroke = 0.18,
      size = 1.8,
      alpha = 0.75,
      position = position_jitter(width = 0.13, height = 0)
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = ra_palette, drop = FALSE) +
    labs(
      title = panel_title,
      x = "Reporting Area",
      y = y_label,
      fill = "Reporting Area"
    ) +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1, byrow = TRUE)) +
    theme_biomarker_ms()
}
```

## Figure: P450, SOD, and Biomarker IBR

```{r fig-biomarker-3panel, fig.width=12, fig.height=4.8, dpi=400, fig.cap="Figure X. Site-level biomarker distributions across Puget Sound reporting areas. Boxplots show median and interquartile range; points represent individual sites. Dashed lines indicate the reference-centered zero line used for standardized biological response metrics."}
p_p450 <- make_biomarker_box(
  df = plot_df,
  y_var = "p450",
  y_label = "P450 activity",
  panel_title = "P450 activity"
)

p_sod <- make_biomarker_box(
  df = plot_df,
  y_var = "sod",
  y_label = "SOD activity",
  panel_title = "SOD activity"
)

p_ibr_bio <- make_biomarker_box(
  df = plot_df,
  y_var = "ibr_bio",
  y_label = "IBR Biomarker",
  panel_title = "IBR Biomarker"
)

fig_biomarker_3panel <- (p_p450 | p_sod | p_ibr_bio) +
  plot_layout(ncol = 3, guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A") &
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14)
  )

fig_biomarker_3panel
```

## Save figure

```{r save-figure}
fig_dir <- file.path("..", "output", "figures")
if (!dir.exists(fig_dir)) dir.create(fig_dir, recursive = TRUE)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(fig_dir, "Fig_biomarker_3panel_reporting_area.png"),
  plot = fig_biomarker_3panel,
  width = 12,
  height = 4.8,
  dpi = 400,
  bg = "white"
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(fig_dir, "Fig_biomarker_3panel_reporting_area.pdf"),
  plot = fig_biomarker_3panel,
  width = 12,
  height = 4.8,
  bg = "white"
)
```
